title: Storm work-register
description: The complete catalogue of Theodor Storm's works. Each work has a permanent TS identifier, independent of whether the house has staged it.

blocks.description: Genre hundreds-blocks; the leading digit encodes genre.

id.description: Permanent handle. Never renumber; new works append within their block.

year.description: First-publication (Erstdruck) year; for a piece unpublished in the author's lifetime, the year of composition (Entstehung), noted in `note`. Null when unverified.

incipit.description: First line (poems); used when the title is generic.

embedded_in.description: Host work if the poem is embedded (e.g. a song inside a Novelle).

ll_band.description: Laage/Lohmeier volume the work sits in.

doubtful.description: Doubtful attribution, fragment, or otherwise uncertain.

status.description: House staging status; orthogonal to the identifier.

play.description: khai play slug of the staged production, or null. The crosswalk to registry.json.
